resume_instructions.before_each_linkedin_post: Check the corresponding Medium publication ledger entry. If its article is public, replace the clearly labelled author-profile fallback with that published article URL and label it Read on Medium.

resume_instructions.limits: Publish at most three new LinkedIn posts per day and per batch. No automatic scheduling has been created.
